messages:
maria_security: Auditor just asked for a 'proof matrix' that ties RBAC changes -> audit logs -> KMS key events. Can we sketch what artifacts we'll hand over?
alex_oncall: We typically provide rolebinding diffs, CloudTrail/Splunk exports, and KMS key metadata + rotation history.
maria_security: They also want a short 'live playback' showing a role change applied and the corresponding log entries. Safe to do in staging?
auditor_james: Staging is fine as long as you sanitize identifiers. A recorded playback with the queries you run is ideal.
ben_platform: I can prepare a disposable service account and an automated rolebinding change that we can replay. Will scope it to a single namespace.
maria_security: Great — can you paste the Splunk/CloudTrail query you'll use so I can include it in the evidence bundle?
ben_platform: Here's the Splunk query I'll run for the demo (will parameterize index & host):
```splunk
index=cloudtrail sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail (eventName=CreateRole OR eventName=UpdateRole OR eventName=PutRolePolicy) | sort 0 _time desc | table _time, userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName, eventName, requestParameters
```
alex_oncall: For KMS rotation history we'll export key metadata and rotation status via the API. Quick commands: 
```bash
aws kms describe-key --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab --profile redwood-staging
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab --profile redwood-staging
```
maria_security: Auditor also asked for proof of the emergency access procedure (breakglass): who ran it, the justification text, and the audit trail. @deploy-bot any recent runbook executions we can attach?
deploy-bot: runbook execution found: runbook-breakglass-2024-11-18.log (redacted). Attached to thread.
auditor_james: Please include commit hashes for the IaC that applied the rolebinding, and the CI job build ID that executed it. Those link code -> runtime.
maria_security: I'll collect: rolebinding-diff.patch, cloudtrail-export.csv, splunk-query.txt, kms-rotation.json, runbook-breakglass-2024-11-18.log, ci-build-6789.log, and a short MP4 of the playback.
ben_platform: I'll create the disposable SA and schedule the rehearsal window. It will be deleted immediately after. :thumbsup:
alex_oncall: Reminder to scrub customer UUIDs, IPs, and any PII from logs before packaging. Use the sanitizer script in infra/tools/log-scrub.
maria_security: Plan: artifacts ready by EOD tomorrow, rehearse with @auditor_james Thursday 9am PT. If anyone has extra evidence suggestions call them out now.
auditor_james: That schedule works. If you can also include a short mapping doc that shows which SOC2/ISO control each artifact satisfies, that's very helpful. Thanks!
